notes: First run (10 samples, 1 s warmup/measurement) had slopes 4.2604/1.1412/6.9085/8.0107 ms respectively; repeated with the same binary after local builds finished.

Other projects and applications remained active with high CPU and memory pressure. The repeat is still above the earlier archived player baseline; performance regression acceptance is inconclusive and requires a controlled rerun.

Track cases measure ClipNode reset and first block including local BPM 120, project BPM 240 and duration 1 local beat; ordinary cases measure the player at rate 2 or ratio 0.5. Assets and nodes are constructed outside measurement.
All three sample modes have zero allocation/free during node reset and a mid-clip seek/render. This microbenchmark does not establish device callback, worker soak or xrun acceptance.
